description2: The Play-ins will feature 9 teams battling it out to earn a spot at the Finals. The top 4 teams from the Play-ins will join the 8 top-seeded teams, and form the 12 teams who will compete to be winners of the FFWS 2022 Bangkok.nnThe teams will battle over 8 rounds – across 4 maps – to be the last one standing, with points awarded based on round ranking and the number of eliminations.
